sql.query: SELECT rp.id grantId FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='tenant.users.edit' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:actor AND utr.tenantId=:tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 LIMIT 1

UPDATE tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=ut.userId SET ut.positionLevel=CASE WHEN :level IN ('executive','director','manager','team_member') THEN :level2 ELSE 'team_member' END,ut.reportsToUserId=CASE WHEN :manager=ut.userId THEN NULL WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants boss WHERE boss.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND boss.userId=:manager2 AND boss.isActive=1) THEN :manager3 ELSE NULL END,ut.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,u.jobTitle=NULLIF(TRIM(:jobTitle),''),u.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ut.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.userId=:userId AND :allowed>0
